meet.hero_headline: A neighbor running because people should come before power.
meet.hero_sub: Cassandra Echeverria is running for Alderperson of Ward 6 in Aurora, Illinois. Not to build a career, but to build hope, one block and one conversation at a time.
meet.why_title: A simple idea. A lot of work ahead.
meet.why_pull: “I'm running on a simple idea: People should come before power.”
meet.why_desc: Cassandra puts it plainly. Safer neighborhoods come from accountability and public safety that is centered on the community. Neighbors without housing, and families who are struggling, should get practical solutions and dignity, not a push out of sight.
meet.why_quote: “It means investing in our neighborhoods, our youth, and the services that help Aurora residents actually thrive.”
meet.why_desc2: She is asking Ward 6 for a chance to represent the people who live here, and she wants to earn that trust by listening first.
meet.why_quote2: “This campaign is powered by everyday people, like yourself, and NOT corporations.”
meet.story_intro: Cassandra is a Ward 6 neighbor who decided that waiting for someone else to run was not good enough. Here is what she is about.
meet.story_roots_text: Cassandra lives in Ward 6 and is running to represent the people she sees every day. She chose this race because this is where her neighbors are.
meet.story_work_text: Cassandra is not asking for the seat because of a title. She is asking for it to do the work: show up, hear people out, and bring what she hears to City Hall.
meet.story_family_text: The schools, the streets, the services families depend on. Those are the things that make a ward feel like home, and they are why Cassandra decided to run.
meet.story_community_text: This campaign is built the way Cassandra wants to serve: one conversation at a time, with neighbors who believe Ward 6 deserves a real choice.
meet.values_1_text: Everyone in Ward 6 deserves to feel safe. That means public safety that is centered on the community and answers to it.
meet.values_2_text: Unhoused neighbors and struggling families are people, not problems to move out of sight. They deserve practical help and respect.
meet.values_3_text: Our neighborhoods, our young people and the services that help families thrive are worth investing in, starting now.
meet.cta_title: It starts with neighbors like you.
meet.cta_text: Join the team, knock a few doors, or chip in what you can. This campaign is powered by neighbors, not corporations.
